title: Approval delegations
subtitle: Delegate approval authority for a period
info: While a delegation is active, the delegate sees your approval inbox and can decide; the decision is recorded "on your behalf". A delegation can be revoked.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end date cannot be before the start date.
errors.required: Delegate and date range are required.
errors.generic: The operation could not be completed.

confirm.title: Revoke this delegation?
confirm.description: The delegate will no longer see or decide approvals under this delegation. Past decisions are kept.

adminInfo: As an administrator you can create delegations on behalf of any employee or revoke them.
